ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Seminar for first-year graduate students and second half of the introductory graduate sequence focused on the process of writing an original piece of historical scholarship. Topics include: developing an argument, exploring sources, arriving at a research strategy, planning and structuring an article, presenting complex data, and producing scholarship that is a coherent representation of the author's findings. Over the course of the semester, each seminar participant will develop and write an original, article-length research paper. Students will work with the assistance of the instructor and an advisor from her or his own research field. Prerequisite: HIST 593.
